name: Densetsu no Ato de Love Love no Shou
original_name: 伝説の後で・ラブラブの章
source:
This is a story about how Ryosuke and Makoto became lovers. They meet during spring, play at the sea during summer, participate in the sports festival during autumn and warm up at boy's room during winter. In the last chapter it's possible to request the girl to fulfill sex fetishes.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
這是亮介和真琴成為戀人的故事。他們在春天相識，夏天去海邊玩，秋天一起參加運動會，入冬後再到男孩的房間裡取暖。到了最後一章，玩家還能向女孩提出請求，讓她配合自己的性喜好。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
